::: {.callout-tip title="TL;DR" icon="false"}
Self-supervised learning manufactures labels from the data itself, learning
representations without annotation: **contrastive** methods (SimCLR, MoCo),
**self-distillation** (DINO), and **masked reconstruction** (MAE, He 2022) —
the vision analogue of BERT's masked-token objective.
:::

**Depends on:** [Word Embeddings](../01_rnn/00_embeddings.qmd)
